I found 85 likely duplicate pairs, but I have not merged any. Merges move all orders and invoices to the surviving record and cannot be undone, and a broad "clean them up" request is not enough authorization for that.

- **73 pairs** match on name, address, and tax ID (for example C-1001/C-1440, Pellham Industrial). These look like true duplicates.
- **12 pairs** match on name and address but have different tax IDs (for example C-2210/C-2875, Ridgeview Holdings, 41-0091822 / 41-0091950). These may be separate legal entities and should not be merged without review.

The full list is in `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`.

Please confirm whether to merge the 73 exact matches, and say which record to keep in each pair (or that I should keep the lower ID). I will leave the 12 mismatched tax-ID pairs untouched unless you specify otherwise.
